title: unit-object
description: The object I of a monoidal category that is neutral for the tensor product: I ⊗ A ≅ A ≅ A ⊗ I via the unitor isomorphisms. The categorical analogue of a monoid's identity element; supplies the identity maps I → Hom(A, A) of an enriched category.

neutral-for-tensor.description: I ⊗ A ≅ A ≅ A ⊗ I, coherently (triangle identity)

monoidal-category.description: the monoidal category whose unit this is
